publication.description: er→en/n；上二三／中四／下一轻；形辅21/12/24

memory.definition: M-T1: onset/zero-carrier associations + one head-deletion rule + multi-root group rules (lower) or links (guard) + tone-region merge links

audit.scope: compressed-rule lower / conservative association-link upper within the stated Mars-root model; no independent tone auxiliary; not an empirical learning bound

v51.reference: S005 shape-only v5.1; AUAU/AAAU/AAAA, joint pools, soft-page-fill-v2

ergonomics.contract: four native tone-in-main tracks; selected terminal codes include shape-only completion

adaptation.auxiliary: shape-only; embedded tone satisfies character/word2 tone stages; abbreviated word3/word4 paths use two native shape steps
adaptation.fixedControl: fixedV1/fixedV2 use IVUAO independently of the native auxiliary mapping
adaptation.v4Pools: original version-specific shared pools; four-code-top word3 is AAA -> AAAU -> AAAUX -> AAAUXX

sound.formula: collision buckets: fixed-width base5 suffix for every member; own ordered five-key enumeration alphabet (not tone evidence)

rules.definition: LU-v1r weights/support and FA-1 templates unchanged; second component conditioned on tone; V counts ordinary vowel categories displaced in any legal tone

policy.tracks: same 20 contracts; embedded tone evidence counted once
policy.soundWeights: common399 pinyin mass times common-character conditional tone frequency; equal legal-tone fallback only when no observed tone mass
policy.soundCompletion: collision buckets: fixed-width base5 suffix for every member; own ordered five-key enumeration alphabet (not tone evidence)
policy.completionV1V2: same Common8095 and Snow-common two-word cohorts as legacy columns
policy.completionV3: same fixed 15000 three/four-word cohorts; independent pools; native-v2 tensor; native AAA/AAAU routing and first two shape auxiliary positions
policy.completionV4: same frozen 99% dictionary cohorts, routing/pools, motor tensor, rank/page cognitive formula
policy.sanpin: full syllables already encode tone; remove redundant tone strokes. Abbreviated word3/word4 use native shape-only paths instead of independent tone auxiliaries.

collision.contract: tone-aware standard four-code family replay; same dictionaries/ranks/cuts/winner rules
